explainer: shap.LinearExplainer (exact for a linear model in log-odds, independent features)

summary_plot.sampling: seeded uniform sample (seed 42) of the validation split

notes: Importance = mean |SHAP| over every row of the split, in the model's output space (log-odds); equal values share a rank and are not a ranking.
Skill features (counts and ratios in features-v1) have small, sometimes negative contributions under a tree ensemble, whose output moves in steps (docs/adr/0015, 0016): read them as approximate.
The model was trained on weak (rule-based) labels, so these importances describe what it learned from those rules (e.g. branch_match), not necessarily what makes a real fit (docs/adr/0015).
